plants.original: British counter-terrorism police arrested a senior US Army soldier, 41, near Gloucester on Tuesday on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence. He was held under two sections of the National Security Act 2023 and is in custody at a London police station, where police can hold him up to 14 days without charge. He was reportedly serving with NATO's Allied Rapid Reaction Corps at Imjin Barracks. Police are searching two sites in Gloucestershire and say the case is unrelated to other counter-terror investigations.
